text:
An object has a constant temperature.
Which statement is correct?
A
There is no energy transfer to or from the object.
B
The rate at which the object receives energy is the same as the rate at which it transfers
energy away.
C
The rate at which the object receives energy is smaller than the rate at which it transfers
energy away.
D
The rate at which the object receives energy is greater than the rate at which it transfers
energy away.

options.label: A
options.text: There is no energy transfer to or from the object.

options.label: B
options.text: The rate at which the object receives energy is the same as the rate at which it transfers

options.label: C
options.text: The rate at which the object receives energy is smaller than the rate at which it transfers

options.label: D
options.text: The rate at which the object receives energy is greater than the rate at which it transfers
